capability: Give every shape one fixed meaning
title: Every shape gets one pin.

hook.picture: Close on the whale drawing a circle on slide one to mean a team, then drawing another circle on slide two to mean a step.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: In my slides a circle means three different things.

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: twelve slides. Each time the whale redraws a shape from scratch, it picks up a new meaning (every 2 beats, then 1, then half).
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Each redraw adds a new meaning.

stakes.body: Learners decode your shapes instead of your ideas, and they learn the wrong thing.

solution_hint: One shape, one meaning. Keep a shelf.

metaphor.body: A shelf above the line holds a few shape cards, each pinned to one word. The whale takes shapes from the shelf instead of drawing, so a circle always means the same thing.

steps.picture: Shape cards appear on the shelf, each pinned to one word: circle = team, square = changed, double border = step.
The whale takes shapes from the shelf instead of drawing. Every slide reuses the same card, with a tick each time.
steps.words: Take it from the shelf. Never redraw.
steps.sound: The same pluck on each reuse.

steps.picture: Push-in: the whale tries to make the circle mean a risk. The pin holds and refuses. The whale makes a new triangle and pins it to risk.
steps.words: New idea? New shape. Old pins hold.
steps.sound: A blocked thud, then a new tuned pluck.

steps.picture: The shelf grows by one card. The strip of slides reads the same top to bottom.

real_case.claim: The Motion Atlas node 'Whiteboard vector diagram' says: give each shape a fixed meaning, save finished objects to a stencil library, and run a render-export-compare loop.

honest_limit.picture: A shape used exactly by its pinned meaning still carries a wrong claim next to it. Consistent symbols do not make a true slide.
honest_limit.words: The right shape can carry a wrong claim.

not_this.body: Consistent shapes are not a true story.

ending_pattern.body: The FELT slides return with both circles meaning team, then the camera pulls back to reveal this film's own symbol shelf.
ending_pattern.callback: Same two slides as bars 1 to 3, the clashing circle meanings now one.

end_belief.body: Give each shape one job. Reuse it.
